reviews.author: Joseph Turbeville
reviews.text: My son was returning to school when his thermostat went out. Had him repaired and back on the road, on a weekend and after closing, just because “it wasn’t right to let him be stranded”. Awesome place! Awesome owner! Can’t recommend highly enough!

reviews.author: Brian Heffner
reviews.text: The owner was amazing. Answered phone on Saturday his day off. Our truck wouldn't start after Newberry Graduation. Had it towed to his shop. He fixed it so we could make it home!! THANKS for allowing us to get our graduate moved home.

reviews.author: Monique Jackson
reviews.text: I’m from Georgia and I was visiting SC for the weekend for personal reasons and my car’s alternator went out close to this establishment. It was Saturday so I knew my choices were limited but I went on a whim and reached out & Brian answered and told me he could help. After arriving, I could already tell I was in good hands because people would drive by and honk their horns at him. He even wanted to get to know us a bit which I thought was another good thing. He ended up fixing my car in less than 24 hrs! It could’ve been same day but we arrived kind of late. Honestly if I lived here I would go back anytime my car needed assistance. I would definitely recommend his services to anybody needing help with their cars. Thank you Brian again for being so caring & attentive to our needs!

reviews.author: Quinton Lais
reviews.text: Very great buisness with reasonable prices. He's has also been very patient with me on payments. He does his job quick and he does it very well. 10/10 would go here for any problem I have with my vehicle.

reviews.author: Lorie Jaynes
reviews.text: Our grandson and girlfriend were stranded with car trouble near Newberry I called All Automotive on Saturday afternoon to help and this wonderful gentleman was kind enough to come back into the shop and repair their car. I cannot thank him enough for saving the day. Thank you so very much!!!

reviews.author: Brittany Pate
reviews.text: In the pouring rain fixing our car. This kind younng man was so friendly and proficient and handled everything so efficiently. We would recommend this business to anyone.

reviews.author: Rebecca Burch
reviews.text: Our car broke down while we were on our way to the beach, this was the only shop that was able to get us in on a holiday weekend on a Sunday. Without him we would have been stuck in Newberry without a car for several more days. He replaced the thermostat and had us back on the road in just a few hours! The kindest man, he saved our vacation!
